description: This file contains SwiftUI-based unit tests and test suite definitions for the 'CronJobEditor' component within the OpenClaw project. It includes helper methods to instantiate views, and various test functions to verify the UI and behavior of cron job editing features, including different job configurations.

classes.name: CronJobEditorSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite structure for verifying the UI and behavior of the CronJobEditor component.

methods.description: Helper method to instantiate a CronJobEditor view with optional job and store parameters.

methods.description: Test verifying that the StatusPill component constructs its body for different statuses.

methods.description: Test verifying the rendering of the CronJobEditor view for a new job.
